title: Calculator Plug
keywords: Holds a circuit board to contribute stability to a Locator platform

blocks.text: Holds a circuit board to contribute stability to a Locator platform.

rows: Place the plug at controller height on Stable Stone.
Read the active state and recheck the surrounding Locator square.

blocks.text: A dirty chip or unanalysed/unstable board is not a stabilizing board. Plugs are not generic FE storage blocks.
